svg.title: RAM map of the Ver.1 firmware
svg.desc: Each nibble coloured by the task that writes it (measured); page 0 labelled.

svg.text: Colour = the main-loop task or interrupt with the most instructions writing the nibble (measured from access traces).

svg.text: Loops that sweep more than 48 nibbles (clears, block copies) are not counted; outlined = written only by them.

svg.text: Page 0 holds the game state; the stack grows down from 0FF.
